title: operator_signal_note_v0
description: Inspectable artifact for extracting hypotheses and structured signals from operator-entered football notes. This schema does not authorize downstream ranking mutation or autonomous decision-making.

note_id.description: Stable identifier for the operator signal note artifact.

source_type.description: Origin class for the note, for example operator_entered_note.

raw_note.description: Exact freeform football note entered by the operator.

entities.description: Detected football entities preserved for inspection.

detected_metrics.description: Metrics detected from the raw note. Metric extraction confidence is not source-truth confidence.

signal_tags.description: Inspectable tags for triage. Tags do not imply verified truth or downstream application.

reasoning_status.description: Reasoning posture for the artifact; no value permits automatic ranking mutation by default.

required_followups.description: Checks required before any downstream interpretation or application.

do_not_apply.description: Explicit non-application rules that prevent automatic ranking, projection, recommendation, or decision changes from this note alone.

uncertainty.description: Preserved ambiguity, missing context, or source-verification gaps.

interpretation_summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the extracted hypothesis or signal.

entity_type.description: Minimum supported entity classes for operator football notes.

name.description: Canonical or display name when available from the note or verified identity resolution.

id.description: Optional stable identifier if known; must not be fabricated.

value.description: Literal entity value, useful for season entities such as 2025.

raw_text.description: Exact entity text span or literal fragment from the operator note.

metric.description: Generic football metric name such as catchable_target_rate, epa_per_play, route_participation, target_share, or pressure_rate.

value.description: Metric value as detected from the note. Null is allowed when a metric is referenced without a value.

unit.description: Unit for the metric value, such as percent, epa_per_play, share, count, rate, text, or unknown.

context.description: Human-readable context for the metric as expressed by the note.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence or verification posture. This must not be read as proof that the football claim is true.

sample_filter.description: Sample or filter phrase from the note, such as red-zone targets or with CMC on field.
